title: The Booking page screens are built (still switched off)
text: The screens of the Booking page are in, hidden until it is switched on. Only you will see a Booking item in the menu: pick a person (or someone new), the kind of call and the length, check what the system will do when it is booked, then copy the link. A list shows every link you made and what happened to it, and you can stop one. A section at the bottom, Calls to check, holds the bookings the system could not settle by itself, with buttons such as Same person: link this email. An invalid link just takes the visitor to the normal booking page. The day-to-day Calendar is not changed. Also fixed: a second call on the same day no longer disappears from a contact's Booked calls.
